problems.quote: Manager explicitly understands no words in the plea; source paragraph22 corrects earlier expectation
problems.evidence: “Did you understand even a single word?” the manager asked the parents, “Is he playing the fool with us?” ... “That was an animal's voice,” said the manager
problems.explanation: The manager never says outright that he understood nothing: he asks the parents a question and calls the voice an animal's, and the conclusion that 'people did not understand his words' is Gregor's own inference, so 'explicitly' overstates an inference as stated fact.

result.note: Nearly all records stay within the text read so far or are labelled as sketches, guesses or inferences; the only overstatement is the 'explicitly' claim about the manager's comprehension.
